description: Reads a task video run: by its run id, or the newest run of a task. Answers its state (queued, running, waiting, complete, errored, terminated), who started it, what it is doing now in plain words, and once it has ended, what it made: links to the MP4 and the poster that last about an hour (ask again for fresh ones) the report it was attached to and which of the customer's logos the film drew (from the brand kit or the page header, with its digest) or why it drew none, or why no film was made, in plain words; and its words with what they were made from: the plan's task facts, the planner's notes and the workspace's directions, the words each slot was given, and every copywriter's part (plan and render) with its outcome, its reason and its model's raw answer. Ask again no more than every 30 seconds while it runs.

task.description: The task, to read its newest video run. Give run or task.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: get_task_video
title: Read a task's video
